verdict.rationale: Alloy markets "agentic automation" for KYC/AML, so a buyer could fairly ask whether its agents can call external MCP tools. The axis applies, but nothing in the pack documents MCP client support or any way to connect MCP servers. The llms.txt, OpenAPI and webhook items are machine-readable or outbound surfaces, not MCP tool consumption, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
